strings.AdbSync {0} — copia incrementale Android: AdbSync {0} — incremental Android → PC copy over ADB
strings.Origine (telefono) → Destinazione (PC): Source (phone)  →  Destination (PC)   ·   Update mode (copies new and changed files, never deletes anything)
strings.File con stessa dimensione ma data diver: Files with the same size but a different date:
strings.verifica rapida (primi e ultimi 64 KB) e: quick check (first and last 64 KB) and align dates
strings.verifica MD5 completa e allinea le date: full MD5 check and align dates
strings.Utile se i file sul PC sono stati copiat: Useful if the files on the PC were copied in the past (e.g. via MTP) without keeping the original date.
strings.Su dischi FAT/exFAT le date possono risu: On FAT/exFAT disks dates may appear shifted by one hour when daylight saving time changes.
strings.Conflitto = il file sul PC è più recente: Conflict = the file on the PC is newer and different. Normally it is left untouched.
strings.Calcola l'MD5 sul telefono e sul PC per: Computes the MD5 on the phone and on the PC for every copied file. Guarantees integrity but is slower.
strings.Se per questi secondi non arriva alcun b:
If no byte arrives for this many seconds the file is considered stalled: it is put back at the end of the queue (without waiting) and retried after the others.
Very low values (1-3 s) help with many stalled files, but a large file with normal pauses might restart several times.
strings.Per i file presenti su entrambi con stes:
For files present on both sides with the same name and size but a different date (e.g. copied in the past via MTP).
Quick: exact for files up to 128 KB; for larger ones it checks the beginning and the end.
MD5: reads the whole file on the phone and on the PC.
strings.A ogni confronto salva in logs\\diagnost: At every comparison saves to logs\diagnostica_<date> the full list of phone files, PC files and the plan, with the reason for each decision.
